缓存命中率 = 已报告缓存读取 tokens / 这些请求的完整输入 token: Cache hit rate = reported cache-read tokens / full input tokens for those requests. Unreported and older records are excluded; zero is shown only when explicitly reported. Cache writes are separate and CTX still counts the full context. This is not a cost-savings rate.
为复用供应商前缀缓存，已发送的历史表示保持不变；上下文摘要、配置或历史内容修改后: Sent history representations stay unchanged to support provider prefix-cache reuse. They rebuild after context summaries, configuration changes or history edits. A zero input-reduction estimate does not mean a provider cache miss.

历史仅追加，已有前缀保持一致: History appended; existing prefix is unchanged
超出本地比较范围，无法确认完整前缀: Comparison limit reached; full prefix could not be verified
供应商未报告有效缓存读取量: Provider did not report valid cache-read usage
比较同一会话、同一用途相邻实际请求的结构，不代表供应商缓存仍有效。历史块数不是: Compares consecutive actual requests for the same conversation and purpose. It does not confirm that a provider cache is still valid. History blocks are not tokens; retention, minimum length and routing remain provider decisions.
匹配历史块 {0} / {1} · 本次 {2} 块: Matching history blocks {0} / {1} · {2} blocks in this request
推理或生成参数已变化；是否影响缓存取决于供应商。: Reasoning or generation parameters changed; cache impact depends on the provider.
缓存策略或断点已变化；移动断点不等于历史内容变化。: Cache policy or breakpoints changed; moving a breakpoint does not mean history content changed.
实际发送模型请求后显示诊断。: Diagnostics appear after an actual model request is sent.
估算仅比较最近请求在相同提示与工具下精简前后的输入，不是账单或未启用插件的真实费: Estimates compare the latest input before and after reduction with the same prompt and tools, not billing or actual costs without the plugin. Summary requests count separately. Disabling does not undo saved summaries; original history remains available.
从启用此版本起累计，含重试和失败请求已返回的用量；供应商未报告的部分不估填。: Cumulative from this version, including usage reported by retries and failed requests. Unreported usage is not filled with estimates.
未报告 {0} 次 · 部分报告 {1} 次 · 失败或中断 {2} 次: Unreported {0} · Partially reported {1} · Failed or interrupted {2}
本次没有可安全精简的历史；最近轮次和关键约束优先保留。: No history was safely reduced this time. Recent turns and key constraints take priority.
另有 {0} 条记录未在此展开。: Another {0} changes are not listed here.
节省建议：先使用代码索引、行范围和现有 diff；只有步骤已确定时才合并工具。高: Tip: prefer code indexes, line ranges and existing diffs. Combine tools only when steps are already decided. Advanced excerpts can omit details; recall originals when needed.

内置插件 · 精简请求副本，保留本地原始历史；不改变权限、审批和工具执行顺序。: Built-in plugin. Reduces request copies and keeps original local history. Permissions, approvals and execution order stay intact.
按轮次自动生成历史摘要: Summarize older history by turn count
默认达到 12 轮且旧历史至少 2048 tokens 后生成摘要，保留最近 5: By default, summarize after 12 turns when older history reaches 2048 estimated tokens, keeping the latest 5 turns verbatim. Existing primary/fallback compaction models are used and incur extra usage. The independent 85% window safeguard may include newer history when necessary. Explicit requests for detail take priority.
精简运行时提示并按任务加载代码提示: Minify runtime context and load coding prompts as needed
仅作用于较早历史。保留最新轮次、用户约束、错误和工具配对；摘录带原文召回入口。启: Applies only to older history. Recent turns, user constraints, errors and tool pairs are preserved. Excerpts include original recall references. Consider the task's detail requirements before enabling.
